Objective: Identify decision-makers at independent European freight forwarders (3-100 staff, air and/or ocean, international agent networks, email-heavy RFQ/agent workflows) as design partners for a free 4-6 week AI freight-forwarding co-pilot pilot. No prospect was contacted.
Geography (priority order): Netherlands > Germany > United Kingdom > Switzerland. No other countries were searched; 1 non-European candidate (Brazil) surfaced and was excluded.
Primary source: Apollo.io via its official MCP integration (OAuth). Free: organizations_lookup (company discovery). Credit-consuming: organizations_bulk_enrich (company validation: headcount, city, founding year, keywords, parent/ownership, M&A events).
Apollo plan limitation: Connected Apollo account is on the Free plan: people search (mixed_people/api_search), person enrichment (people/match, people/bulk_match) and the Apollo AI agent return API_INACCESSIBLE. Therefore NO professional emails could be revealed or verified, and Apollo could not be used for people discovery.
Supplementary source: Clay search-contacts (free public professional profile search, official MCP integration) used to identify current decision-makers at each screened company (max 2 per company, Tier 1/Tier 2 title + seniority filters, incl. German/Dutch/French titles).
Apollo discovery filters: Keyword tags: freight forwarding, air freight, ocean/sea freight, NVOCC, expediteur/expeditie, Spedition, Luftfracht, Seefracht; locations: Netherlands, Germany, United Kingdom, Switzerland; employee ranges 3-10, 11-50, 51-100.
Clay people query: select from people where experiences.any(is_current = true and (job_title is_similar_to (Managing Director, Owner, Founder, CEO, Director, General Manager, Head of Operations, Air/Ocean Freight Manager, Geschäftsführer, Inhaber, Directeur, Eigenaar) or seniority in (Founder, Owner, Partner, C-suite))) limit 2 by clay_company_id
Exclusion rules: Shipping lines, airlines, pure trucking/road, warehousing-only, couriers, pure customs brokers, freight-tech/software, recruiters, multinationals, subsidiaries of larger groups (parent detected via Apollo owned_by_organization, M&A events or company profile), >100 employees, HQ outside Europe, junior contacts.
Scoring: Company fit 40 (independence 10, size 8, air/ocean 8, agent network 7, email-heavy ops 7) + Decision-maker fit 35 (owner/founder/CEO 35, MD 33, ops/GM/COO 29, generic director 28, freight manager 25, sales 25, road/warehouse roles 10) + Pilot suitability 25 (lean team 10, workflow complexity 8, willingness/authority 7). Shortlist threshold: overall >= 65. Best 2 contacts per company kept.
Credit consumption: 171 Apollo lead credits used of 200 (29 remaining in cycle 2026-11-18 to 2026-12-18), all on company validation: 1 single organizations_enrich capability test + 170 organizations_bulk_enrich matches (170 unique companies enriched). Verified against apollo_usage_stats. No credits purchased, no upgrade, no charges.
Post-credit people search: Apollo credits were not exhausted, so the 'Post-Credit People Search' sheet is intentionally empty.
Email status: 0 verified, 0 unverified - all shortlisted contacts lack an email because Apollo person enrichment is unavailable on the Free plan. Re-run ffresearch.apollo_client.people_bulk_match with a paid-plan APOLLO_API_KEY to fill emails.
Pipeline: Python + SQLite (data/research.db). Raw tool responses checkpointed to data/raw/*.json; idempotent ingest (resume-safe); deterministic scoring; XLSX/CSV build + automated validation (sheet names, headers, <=2 per company, threshold, no duplicates, CSV row count).
